title: Prime-smooth orbit weak/strong reduction and aligned-Gram threshold obstruction

publication.method: guarded non-force merge preserving concurrent main history

mathematical_scope: exact decomposition of the complete between-core packet into weak and strong orbit packets
scalar decay gives |W| <= sqrt(internalEnergy) and hence all-positive-rate weak payment
strong packet is source-equivalent to the complete net packet on every fixed scale set
negative side of the strong packet is paid, so one-sided and absolute complete-strong estimates are equivalent
conditional RH return from an AffineFrequent all-positive-rate strong-packet bound

obstruction.statement: N identical normalized vectors have total diagonal energy one, Gram entries 1/N and ordered off-diagonal cross N-1; every threshold puts the complete cross in either the weak or strong sector
obstruction.scope: generic Gram/threshold method only; not a counterexample to the actual Möbius orbit waveforms
obstruction.consequence: energy matching, total diagonal payment, threshold selection and two-vector Gram Cauchy cannot alone prove the remaining all-positive-rate strong-packet estimate

open_obligations: prove the complete orbit Gram-Cauchy bridge and scalar decay in Lean
prove an arithmetic or operator estimate for the one complete strong orbit packet
obtain an AffineFrequent all-positive-rate bound for that packet
nonclaims: the aligned-Gram example is not asserted of the actual Möbius source
absolute values are permitted only after the one complete strong packet is formed
source publication is not Lean acceptance
